english:
Shabbat
Israeli: no sound of its own; makes b, k, p instead of v, kh, f
Ashkenazi: same; also makes tav t instead of s
Sephardi: same
American synagogue: same as Israeli; a tav with dagesh is always t
Note: Two things share one sign: dagesh kal (begadkefat hardening) and dagesh chazak (doubling). Mappiq (dagesh in a final he) means the he is pronounced.
